verdict.rationale: Twenty documents built-in CSV, XLSX and XLS import for any object, with column-to-field mapping, duplicate detection and error handling. Errors are highlighted in yellow and can be fixed directly in the UI before import, which covers mapping, validation and visible handling of bad rows. Each file may contain only one object type, so contacts and deals need separate imports linked by unique fields such as email or domain. missing for 10: an explicit post-import report or row-count guarantee that no rows are silently dropped, a one-pass multi-object (contacts plus deals) import, and independent or hands-on corroboration of import reliability.

support.subject: As a founder, I can import my spreadsheet of contacts and deals with field mapping and validation, without losing rows silently

citations.quote: Field mapping, duplicate detection, and error handling built in.
Review errors (highlighted in yellow) and fix them, directly editing in the UI
You can import data for any object using CSV, XLSX, or XLS files.
You need to reference the related object using a unique field from this object: the id, the email for People and Workspace Members, the domain for companies
